name: Natalie Incledon
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Empathic and warm clinical psychologist with a passion for improving the wellbeing and lives of others. Highly values a strong working relationship with clients based on trust and honesty.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Trauma Recovery

name: Tessa Lancashire
title: Psychotherapist, Psychodynamic Psychotherapist
description: It can be hard to consider coming to therapy… You might be experiencing chronic pain or recurring physical symptoms. Perhaps you are exhausted and you feel like you have already tried everything.

name: Kathleen Montaigue
title: Psychotherapist, Psychodynamic Psychotherapist
description: I know therapy can feel overwhelming and intense, which is why I’m here to introduce you to Walk & Talk due to its ability to take the pressure out of the therapy hour. For example, by walking side by side, eye contact becomes more natural, conversation too, finds a natural ebb and flow, and there is more space to breath, think, and be present.

name: Rizna Plunkett
title: Integrative Psychotherapist, Soul Centred Psychotherapist
description: Rizna (she/they) is a non-binary & queer Integrative Psychotherapist, Youth Worker and Grief-tender. Their therapeutic approach is gentle, collaborative, rooted in cultural humility, grounded in a steady slowness that rests in curiousity, which aims to respect each person’s lived experience, intergenerational trauma and ancestral history that we all carry.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Sex Related Issues, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Tanya Rae
title: Counsellor, Hypnotherapist
description: I believe that therapy is a space where you can explore yourself without the pressure to be fixed. My vision is to create a supportive environment where you can learn, question, express and reflect, at your own pace.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Paco Romeu Soler
title: Social Worker AMHSW, Psychoanalyst
description: In my practice, each person is met with a deep commitment to listening to the singularity of their experience. Psychoanalysis, as I practice it, offers a calm and collaborative space where you can speak openly about your concerns and difficulties. Prior to working full-time in private practice, I worked for over a decade across diverse clinical settings, including acute adult mental health services, community mental health programs, drug and alcohol services, LGBTIQA+ health support programs, sexual assault services, and SASH at the Royal Children’s Hospital. I also have extensive experience supporting individuals from LGBTIQ+ communities.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Sex Related Issues, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Suzanne Sharp
title: Psychotherapist, Art Therapist
description: Life doesn't come with a user's guide and all of us struggle at times. In looking for a therapist you have taken a step toward finding greater ease in your life.

name: Ché Stevenson
title: Psychotherapist, Counsellor
description: One of the barriers to self-care is allowing yourself to go into the depths of your experiences. Often, we are challenged to explore and understand this profound chasm, to touch what is held there, to hear its messages, and to connect with compassion to the raw emotions that have been lying dormant for years or just surfaced.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, Sex Related Issues, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed
